about: Working with Me — V1 Signal field. Loaded into planner/engineer/designer prompts. Source of truth for design files: docs/design/. Read docs/design/AGENT-NOTES.md before implementing.

components.name: Button
components.description: Pill-shaped, no offset shadow. Variants: pri (ink fill), out (ink border), ghost (rule border), cream, cream-out. NEVER render bare <button>.

components.name: Label
components.description: Eyebrow text — sans 12px, letter-spacing 0.04em, optional signal-coral dot. Variants: default (teal-soft), muted, ink, cream.

components.name: MonoTag
components.description: Small mono ID/timestamp — 11px IBM Plex Mono, muted color.

components.name: Avatar
components.description: Circular initials avatar. Sizes: sm (24), default (32), lg (56). Background = teal, foreground = paper.

components.name: SignalWave
components.description: ASCII-style waveform of seven bars — broadcasts a signal next to a profile/wallet dot.

components.name: CredentialToken
components.description: THE recurring artifact. Teal disc with concentric rings, two parties' names with italic ampersand, signal-coral seal. Used in profile, inbox, gated unlock, network. Sizes: default (220px), sm (84px). Variant: deep (on dark surface).

components.name: BrowserCard
components.description: Profile-screen mock chrome — top bar with three dots + URL pill, body slot. Used to frame Assignment renders.

components.name: ScreenCard
components.description: Full-bleed product-screen card with crumb header + badge — used for inbox, network, gated more screens.

components.name: FaqRow
components.description: Two-column FAQ row — sans 19px question on left, 16px answer on right, hairline divider. NEVER dashed.

components.name: SiteFooter
components.description: Calm footer with brand block + 3 link columns + Built on Andamio pill (toggleable). paper-deep background.

forbiddenPatterns: No raw hex colors in new code — reference tokens.colors.*
No JetBrains Mono — mono is IBM Plex Mono only
No orange-on-foreground reverse cards — that was the Andamio landing pattern; this brand is intentionally different
No dashed horizontal rules as section dividers — use hairlines (--rule) only
No terminal / code blocks as decoration
No Instrument Serif — serif is Newsreader
No offset / hard-drop box-shadows — buttons and cards are pill-shaped or hairline-bordered, no 8px-8px-0 stamps
No window.confirm() / window.alert() — use a dedicated component or inline state
No AI-slop tells: "It's not just X — it's Y", "crucial", "seamless", "leverage", trailing ellipses for drama
No Andamio-internal vocabulary in user-facing copy: course, module, student, teacher, SLT, assignment submission, credential issuance
No Mesh SDK / wallet imports outside files marked 'use client' or app/api/* server routes
No direct fetches to preprod.api.andamio.io from client code — must go through /api/gateway/* or /api/auth/*

voice.tone: Warm, person-to-person, plural voice ("post yours", "see who's working on what"). Warmer than a tool landing, more confident than a manifesto.
rules: Short sentences. Periods on short lines.
No em-dashes. Comma or period instead.
No "It's not just X — it's Y" constructions.
Sentence case for headlines and labels.
User-facing nouns: Assignment, Commitment, Connection, Credential, your space, more about how I work.

notes: Anchor variation is V1 (Signal field). V2 (Index card stack) and V3 (Live ticker) live alongside as inspiration only — on conflict V1 wins. The credential token (CredentialToken component) is the recurring brand artifact and must appear in: public profile, owner inbox, gated 'more' unlock, /network view. Accessibility floor: WCAG AA. All interactive elements show :focus-visible. Mobile-first from 320px. Motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.
